items.description: Acquired a 2027 second-round draft pick and a 2028 fifth-round draft pick from Jacksonville Jaguars for DB Jessie Bates.
Acquired DB Amani Hooker and a 2027 fifth-round draft pick from Tennessee for a 2027 second-round draft pick. Released DB A.J. Woods from the practice squad.
Signed TE Zaire Mitchell-Paden and P Wes Pahl to the practice squad. Released TE John FitzPatrick and DT Eric Johnson II from the practice squad.
Released DB Reddy Steward from the practice squad.

Acquired LB Daiyan Henley from the Los Angeles Chargers for a 2027 fourth-round draft pick and a 2028 fifth-round draft pick. Waived DB Sean Fresch. Released DB Ugochukwu Amadi from the practice squad.
Signed TE Kenny Fletcher Jr. to the practice squad.
Acquired a 2027 second-round draft pick from Buffalo Bills for DB Amani Hooker and a 2027 fifth-round draft pick.
Acquired a 2027 sixth-round draft pick from San Francisco 49ers for WR Keenan Allen.
Waived LB Jack Pyburn.
Acquired a 2027 third-round draft pick, pending a physical from Minnesota Vikings for QB Kirk Cousins.
Signed WR Xavier Smith from San Francisco's practice squad to the active roster. Placed WR Jordan Whittington on injured reserve.
Placed DL Zach Sieler and QB Malik Willis on injured reserve. Waived CB Reese Taylor.

Acquired QB Kirk Cousins from Las Vegas for a 2027 third-round draft pick, pending a physical. Terminated the contract of WR Odell Beckham Jr. Released G C.J. Hanson and T Corey Robinson II from the practice squad.
Signed TEs Matt Lauter and Treyton Welch to the practice squad. Placed TE Stone Smartt on practice squad injured reserve. Released RB Jarquez Hunter from the practice squad.
Waived RB Jaydon Blue.

Signed QBs Joey Aguilar from Jacksonville's practice squad and Josh Johnson from Cincinnati's practice squad to the active roster. Signed WR Phillip Dorsett II to the practice squad. Placed QB Gardner Minshew II and WR Michael Wilson on injured reserve. Released TE Rivaldo Fairweather and RB Jermar Jefferson from the practice squad.
Waived TE Hayden Rucci. Released TE Evan Svoboda from the practice squad.
Acquired WR Keenan Allen from Indianapolis for a 2027 sixth-round draft pick. Placed DT Gracen Halton on injured reserve.
Signed DT Cole Brevard to the practice squad. Released DT Gary Smith from the practice squad.
Signed G Luke Haggard to the practice squad. Released RB Barika Kpeenu from the practice squad. Released WR David Sills.
Released WR David Moore. Placed WR Ihmir Smith-Marsette on practice squad injured reserve. Signed LB Claudin Cherelus to the practice squad.

Acquired DT Jordan Davis from Philadelphia for a 2027 first-round draft pick and a 2029 second-round draft pick. Acquired DB Jessie Bates from Atlanta for a 2027 second-round draft pick and a 2028 fifth-round draft pick. Waived DB Alijah Huzzie.
Signed RB Lucas Scott to the practice squad. Released G Michael Jordan from the practice squad. Released TE Nick Vannett. Waived G Kyle Hergel.
Acquired 2027 second-round and 2028 fifth-round draft picks from Jacksonville Jaguars for S Jessie Bates III.
Elevated WR Trent Sherfield and DB Geno Stone from the practice squad. Placed WR Josh Palmer on injured reserve.
